abstract: Assesses primary battery reserve capacity and autonomous seafloor deployment lifespans
system_message:
You are Power endurance specialist (PWR). The power endurance specialist evaluates primary battery reserve capacity and autonomous seafloor deployment lifespans across benthic lander platforms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Assesses primary battery reserve capacity and autonomous seafloor deployment lifespans（BATT）
information_points.content:
PWR-BATT-TM5：Under the June 2024 deployment period, the Benthic Boundary Surveyor 6000 achieves a seafloor operational endurance of 180 d according to its nominal battery discharge audit prior to dropping below 21 V.
PWR-BATT-QDW：For the June 2024 deployment period, the Abyssal Trench Lander Mk IV demonstrates a seafloor operational endurance of 180 d based on a lithium oxyhalide battery discharge audit projecting autonomous operating duration before primary bus voltage falls below 21 V.
PWR-BATT-BOJ：During the June 2024 deployment period, the Deep Rift Observatory Platform provides a seafloor operational endurance of 120 d projected under full science sampling until the bus voltage declines below 21 V.
PWR-BATT-A5N：For the July 2024 deployment period, the Abyssal Trench Lander Mk IV is evaluated at a seafloor operational endurance of 120 d under its projected autonomous operating duration before the primary bus voltage drops below 21 V.

information_points.title: Quiescent sleep current（SLP）
information_points.content:
PWR-SLP-XPX：Bench testing of the power management board shows that the Abyssal Trench Lander Mk IV draws a quiescent sleep current draw of 15 mA across the central power distribution unit in its dormant low-power state.
PWR-SLP-XMI：The Deep Rift Observatory Platform exhibits a quiescent sleep current draw of 40 mA during bench testing in its subsea dormant low-power state.
PWR-SLP-A0P：Bench measurements of the central power distribution unit indicate that the Benthic Boundary Surveyor 6000 has a quiescent sleep current draw of 25 mA while dormant.
